entry.title: ZaY-o-Nator 1.1.3
entry.summary: Backlit VU meters, LED peak meters and a spectrum on your MPC or Force screen, in classic cream or noir black. Optional Wi-Fi meter sending (UDP, local network only, no audio) for the ZaY-o-Nator Display, sold separately.

entry.title: ZaY-o-Nator 1.1.2
entry.summary: 1.1.2: Send is off until you turn it on (only needed for the ZaY-o-Nator Display, sold separately). Downloads - ZaY-o-Nator-DAW-Plugins-Mac.zip: the VST3 and AU (run "Install ZaY-o-Nator Plugins.command") - ZaY-o-Nator-1.1.2-mpc-sdk.zip: the MPC plugin folder; the -mpc-armv7 / -mpc-aarch64 zips are for the Open MPC Plugin Manager

entry.title: ZaY-o-Nator 1.1.1
entry.summary: 1.1.1: the display's DRUMS face now catches every kick, snare, perc and hat from an audio input (Loopback, interface, MPC over USB), the same way the DAW plugin does. Downloads - ZaY-o-Nator-DAW-Plugins-Mac.zip: the VST3 and AU (run "Install ZaY-o-Nator Plugins.command") - ZaY-o-Nator-Mac.zip / ZaY-o-Nator-Windows.zip: the display - ZaY-o-Nator-1.1.1-mpc-sdk.zip: the MPC plugin folder; the -mpc-armv7 / -mpc-aarch64 zips are for the Open MPC Plugin Manager

entry.title: ZaY-o-Nator 1.1.0
entry.summary: 1.1.0: ZaY-o-Nator for your DAW (VST3 and AU, Mac).
